notes: Phrases that mean the student is asking about something time-varying, which the committed NHS snapshot cannot answer. A match is one of the conditions that opens the gate to a live lookup at a health authority. Matched after MedicalTextAnalyzer normalisation, so terms are authored exactly as a student would type them; Greeklish is reached through the transliteration skeleton and needs no entries of its own. Words shorter than five characters are never stemmed, so a short inflected form needs its own entry alongside the base form. DELIBERATELY ABSENT: «νέα», which means both 'new' and 'news' and appears in ordinary questions, and «σήμερα», which is usually 'what should I do today' rather than a request for current events. A false positive here costs a needless network request and some latency; a false negative just means the student gets the local answer, which is still a good answer. So this list is tuned to be specific rather than broad.
